subject: Agent concurrency & registry add-ons — renewal plan and pricing tradeoffs
messages:
From: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@buildkite.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-enterprises.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal options — agent concurrency and registry connector bundle

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming renewal. I attached a preliminary quote that shows three renewal tiers:
- Standard (same seats, 20% price increase)
- Performance (higher concurrency + priority support)
- Connector Bundle (adds container-registry connector + artifact retention add-on)

A few notes based on what you mentioned last quarter: we can offer a 10% discount if you commit to 12 months on the Performance tier and agree to a 6-month phased rollout for agent concurrency increases (to avoid sudden CI spikes).

I included agent concurrency limits and expected throughput numbers in the PDF. Happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk through.

Best,
Ethan
Account Exec, Buildkite

Attachment: Buildkite_quote_Q4_2026.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — agent concurrency and registry connector bundle

Folks,

Looping you in — Buildkite sent the quote and included a connector bundle for container registry features. Key concerns:
- Cost vs actual agent concurrency we need in steady state (we peak a lot, but tail off).
- Harbor connector pricing is also changing; they charge per-repo for certain features which compounds.
- Procurement will need an itemized quote to raise a PO.

Marcus — can you validate current 90-day concurrency profile and realistic steady-state target? Marissa — can you check retention / artifact egress patterns so we can compare Harbor vs the bundle? Karthik/Dev — any migration/ops complexity for enabling the connector in staging?

Plan: consolidate numbers, push back on list prices, and ask Buildkite for a usage-based cap so we don't overcommit.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Platform Procurement

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — agent concurrency and registry connector bundle

Hannah — quick data dump below (pulled from CI metrics):
- 90-day 95th percentile concurrency: 320 agents
- 90-day 50th percentile: 85 agents
- Peak (single-day high): 620 agents (day of large release)
- Average monthly agent-minutes: ~1.2M

Notes: we have predictable peaks around weekly releases and quarterly migrations. If we negotiate a tier that supports 350 steady-state and allows burst to 650 with burst pricing, that would cover >98% of events.

I attached a short CSV to this thread (uploaded to Jira ticket) with the timeline.

Marcus
Engineering Manager, CI Platform
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — agent concurrency and registry connector bundle

Hannah/Marcus — HarborCorp sales reached out (copied below) with their updated add-on pricing. The main delta is a per-repo retention surcharge for private images that we use for experiments. If we consolidate repos and use repo-labeling to apply retention rules we could keep costs closer to current spend.

Attachment: harbor_registry_addons_pricing.xlsx

Quick recommendation: request a 6-12 month pilot on the connector (metered) before committing to the bundle. That would give us data to prove savings from prefix caching and lifecycle policies.

Marissa
Platform Reliability Lead
From: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@buildkite.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-enterprises.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — agent concurrency and registry connector bundle

Hannah, Marcus — thanks for the data. Two concessions we can make to move forward quickly:
1) Performance tier: hold list pricing but grant a 12% contract discount for a 12-month commit with a usage cap model (steady-state 350 agents; bursts billed at a known marginal rate).
2) Connector Bundle: offer a 3-month pilot for the Harbor connector at no charge; if you opt into the bundle after the pilot, we'll credit the pilot value against the first invoice.

If procurement can provide a PO line and rough billing window, I can get legal to prep a renewal SOW + addendum that clarifies burst billing and connector pilot terms.

Best,
Ethan

Attachment: Buildkite_quote_Q4_2026.pdf (updated)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rowe <ethan.rowe@buildkite.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-enterprises.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Agent concurrency & registry add-ons — renewal plan and pricing tradeoffs

Ethan — thanks for the flexibility. Procurement will prepare a PO for the Performance tier at the 12% discount with the proposed usage cap language; I'll attach the draft PO to the Jira ticket (INFRA-2334) and Marissa will coordinate the 3-month Harbor connector pilot acceptance criteria.

Two actions for next week: 
- Procurement: raise PO draft and confirm billing cadence (Procurement: procurement@acme-enterprises.com).
- CI Platform (Marcus): finalize steady-state agent target and the surge policy so we can include explicit burst thresholds in the SOW.
- Platform Reliability (Marissa): provide acceptance criteria for connector pilot (replication, cache hit rates, retention policy enforcement).

If Buildkite legal can circulate a SOW with burst billing matrix and pilot terms by EOD Friday, we should be able to sign and start the pilot the week after.

Thanks all,
Hannah
Head of Platform Procurement

Attachment: procurement_PO_draft.docx
